validation_gates.reason: The policy-reviewer-role-vocabulary workflow runs only this validator, never the schema. On main it returned PASS for a role carrying records_approval or a named approver, a role without a description or with a malformed code, an alias equal to a role code defined later in the list, and a registry whose status was changed from PROPOSED_INACTIVE; non-list aliases, unhashable aliases or scopes and mixed-type scopes raised TypeError. The existing duplicate_role and authority_leak fixtures were incomplete records (no governance, no roles), so they were denied for a missing section rather than their named defect. The new fixtures and tests fail on the original validator.

Fixtures go from 3 to 6 cases; each DENY case is the tracked registry with one defect, and a test asserts they stay complete records. Unit tests go from 3 to 8 (37 subtests) covering 28 single-defect mutations of the registry, distinct aliases, non-object inputs and the CLI. Branch coverage of the validator rises from 45% to 93%. The workflow's four steps (py_compile, unittest, --registry, --fixtures) pass.

Each of nine changes failed the suite: allowing extra top-level keys, dropping the identity values, allowing extra role keys, dropping the code pattern, the description length, the scope type check, the alias/code overlap, the alias/alias overlap or the alias identifier pattern.

notes: The validator now enforces the schema's shape (fixed identity and PROPOSED_INACTIVE status, no extra keys, required description, code pattern, string scopes) because the workflow runs no schema check, and checks alias overlap after all codes are known. Aliases take the same uppercase snake-case form as codes, per the contract's rule that role identifiers are stable uppercase snake-case tokens (Codex review finding on PR #5278). Aliases stay allowed because the contract describes them, although the schema's role object has additionalProperties false and no aliases property; that contract/schema divergence is left for an owner decision. The tracked registry is unchanged and still passes.
